meta.author: claude
meta.description: Road piece (dirt), level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). A 3-wide road of gravel ruts and a coarse dirt crown with set cobblestones between cobblestone curbs; level 2 adds shoulders of andesite and packed mud with stone slab stepping stones; level 3 grass, ferns, flowers and a lamp post. Tiles end to end.
meta.changes: More varied: gravel ruts, a coarse dirt and cobblestone crown, mossy cobblestone curbs and andesite and packed mud shoulders in a fixed pattern, with stone slab stepping stones down to the grass, flowers and a lamp; the edge posts that showed missing textures (cobblestone walls stored without a state) are gone.
